name: Taylor's Green

layers.essential_history: [[c:Taylor's Green is part of the final route. The path to it and the history to share still need adding after your recce.]]

layers.mystery: [[c:Journal page: you reach a field where the estate's animals once grazed. The steward says he spent the afternoon here.]]

puzzle.title: A walk that cannot add up
puzzle.intro: [[c:The steward gave an account of his afternoon. Test it against the sketch map note.]]
material: [[c:THE STEWARD SAYS: "I left the stable yard at the second bell, walked to the far barn, spent one bell there, and walked back. I was in the yard again by the third bell."]]
[[c:SKETCH MAP NOTE: the walk from the stable yard to the far barn takes one bell each way.]]
puzzle.question: [[c:At the earliest, at which bell could he have been back in the yard? (Type a number.)]]
hints: [[c:Count the walk there, the time at the barn, and the walk back.]]
[[c:He left at the second bell. One bell to get there, one bell at the barn, one bell back.]]
puzzle.reveal: [[c:He could not have been back before the fifth bell, so his claim of the third bell is impossible. His alibi does not hold.]]
puzzle.fallback: [[c:This puzzle uses only the story text, so it works even if you cannot reach the field. Alpacas are a possible bonus sighting, not part of the puzzle.]]

evidence: [[c:The steward's alibi is impossible: he could not have been back at the third bell.]]
directions_to_next: [[c:Directions to be supplied after the recce. Next stop: Cemetery gatehouse.]]
notes: Exact paths and how this joins the cemetery and Big Green are not known yet.
